name: Danyah
overview: Aref and Ahmed are trying to help Azouz catch Danyah's attention. Will she notice and like him? On the other hand, Abeer is jealous of Danyah because of her intelligence and her high grades, but she thinks that Danyah is cheating in exams and tries to investigate that.

trailers.title: إعلان كرتون دانية على كرتون نتورك بالعربية
